title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
description: A short science explainer with a few technical words worth learning.
description_zh: 一篇简短的科普，有几个值得学的术语。

units.text: Have you ever wondered why the sky is blue during the day but red or orange at sunset?
units.translation: 你有没有想过，为什么白天天空是蓝色的，日落时却变成红色或橙色？

units.text: The answer has to do with sunlight and the air itself.
units.translation: 答案与阳光和空气本身有关。

units.text: Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made up of all the colors of the rainbow.
units.translation: 阳光看起来是白色的，其实由彩虹的所有颜色组成。

units.text: Each color travels as a wave, and each wave has a different length.
units.translation: 每种颜色以波的形式传播，波长各不相同。

units.text: Blue light has a short wavelength, while red light has a long one.
units.translation: 蓝光波长短，红光波长长。

units.text: When sunlight enters the atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of gas.
units.translation: 阳光进入大气层时，会撞上微小的气体分子。

units.text: These molecules scatter short waves much more than long ones.
units.translation: 这些分子对短波的散射远比长波强。

units.text: So blue light gets scattered in every direction, and that is what we see when we look up.
units.translation: 所以蓝光被散射到四面八方，我们抬头看到的就是它。

units.text: At sunset, the light has to travel through much more air to reach your eyes.
units.translation: 日落时，光线要穿过厚得多的空气才能到达你的眼睛。

units.text: By then, most of the blue has been scattered away.
units.translation: 到那时，大部分蓝光已经被散射掉了。

units.text: What is left is the red and orange light, which paints the evening sky.
units.translation: 剩下的是红光和橙光，它们把傍晚的天空染上颜色。

units.text: This effect is called Rayleigh scattering, named after the scientist who explained it.
units.translation: 这种现象叫瑞利散射，以解释它的科学家命名。
